transcript: One thing that I haven't really seen people talk about is that in a recent interview, Steven Schwartz said this. What will it take to get wicked part 3 and four? We were actually talking about something which is under wraps, and we can't say too much about it. But it's not called Wicked Part 3 or 4. No. Okay. And so the question is, well, what does that next project in the wicked universe look like? Obviously, with Steven Schwartz on board, we know it's probably gonna be another musical, and I think we can also probably assume it's gonna be another movie. But in terms of story that they could adapt, I think they actually have a couple of options. The most obvious answer would be to adapt son of a witch, which is the direct sequel to the wicked novel. Now, there are some key differences between the wicked novel and the wicked musical that would make this adaptation a little bit challenging. But they could always take the wicked approach and just start from scratch and say, okay, we're doing a story about Elphaba's son. What does that look like? Another sneaky option would be to skip to the third novel, A Lion Among Men. This novel tells the story of the Cowardly Lion in the events after wicked. One of the benefits here is that this more closely follows the wicked formula of, here is a character that you know from The Wizard of Oz. And we are going to tell you a new take on that character. Not to mention the fact that the Cowardly Lion is already a character in wicked, both the musical and the movie. But it's also the character that we know the least about. So it kind of makes sense that the next installment would be giving you more of his story. And the third option, in my eyes, would be instead of going forward, let's look backwards. They already gave us a little bit more of alphabets childhood in part 1, and I wouldn't be surprised if they wanted to expand on that even more in its own movie. Plus, who wouldn't want to see more Doleze bear?
